author: EthanJPerez
text: 🤖🧘 We trained a humanoid robot to do yoga based on simple natural language prompts like "a humanoid robot kneeling" or "a humanoid robot doing splits." How? We use a Vision-Language Model (VLM) as a reward model. Larger VLM = better reward model. https://t.co/4ujAFCliQa 👇 https://t.co/zXpUH11IeH

author: EthanJPerez
text: New paper on the Inverse Scaling Prize! We detail 11 winning tasks & identify 4 causes of inverse scaling. We discuss scaling trends with PaLM/GPT4, including when scaling trends reverse for better & worse, showing that scaling trends can be misleading: https://t.co/N56234HA7i 🧵 https://t.co/Eclz3EZhrD

author: EthanJPerez
text: I spent a day red teaming the ChatGPT+Code Interpreter model for safety failures. I’m not a security expert, but overall I’m impressed with how the model responds to code-specific jailbreaking attempts & have some requests for improvements. 🧵 on my takeways+requests to @OpenAI:

author: EthanJPerez
text: We found big gains over finetuning with human feedback (as in RLHF), by using human preferences during pretraining itself. Who knows if we’d be seeing all of these language model jailbreaks if we’d pretrained w/ human prefs… All the benefits of pretraining, with better safety

quoted.text: You can (and should) do RL from human feedback during pretraining itself! In our new paper, we show how training w/ human preferences early on greatly reduces undesirable LM behaviors, including under adversarial attack, w/o hurting downstream performance. https://t.co/YZSGnrT6lD https://t.co/SwGz0plRmF

author: EthanJPerez
text: Huge shoutout to @HelloSurgeAI for evaluating the data quality of so many diverse datasets, with <1-2 week turnaround times and barely any effort from us! As I've said before, everyone should be using Surge for data collection

author: EthanJPerez
text: 🥉Modus Tollens: Infer that a claim “P” must be false, if “Q” is false and “If P then Q” is true - a classic form of logical deduction. Issue holds even after finetuning LMs w/ human feedback via RL from Human Feedback (RLHF) and Feedback Made Easy (FeedME). https://t.co/dmKYC0XGJj

author: EthanJPerez
text: We’re awarding prizes to 7/48 submissions to the Inverse Scaling Prize Round 2! Tasks show inverse scaling on @AnthropicAI @OpenAI @MetaAI @DeepMind models, often even after training with human feedback. Details at https://t.co/bhgZwMioJi and 🧵 on winners:

text: @icmlconf Could you please elaborate on why using LLMs to help write is not allowed? This rule disproportionately impacts my collaborators who are not native English speakers
